about_the_game:
Note: The offer is available as part of the Warhammer Skulls Sale, running in WoT Blitz from May 22 through May 29.

This bundle includes:

• Roboute Guilliman Legendary avatar
• Tor Garadon Legendary avatar
• 3 days of Premium Account
• 330,000 credits

Courage and honor! Grab useful resources and avatars—a Legendary Primarch and the illustrious Captain of the Imperial Fists. Lead your team to victory!

This DLC can be added to your World of Tanks Blitz account only once.
